The residue-energy theorem's overall skeleton (J, w, hK, local-to-global calc) also parallels manuscript_histogram_overlap_energy and manuscript_geometric_box_energy, but the parts that differ are substantial, so I did not report it as a separate finding.

findings.problem: This lemma is a verbatim copy of the private lemma `local_mass_sum` in HistogramOverlapEnergy.lean. Both have the same statement and the same proof, which is a double-counting argument: expand each inner sum with `if`, swap the sums, then bound each column by (overlap count)*w i. The only difference is the name and the `private` modifier. Because the original is private, the author could not reuse it from this file and re-proved it. HistogramOverlapEnergy is already a transitive import here, via HistogramBoxEnergy.
findings.proposed_change: Delete the second proof. In HistogramOverlapEnergy.lean, remove `private` and give the lemma one public name (`sum_selected_cells_le_overlap` is the better name). Its statement stays exactly as at lines 12–15 of this file. Delete the lemma from ResidueBoxEnergy.lean. The call at line 65, `sum_selected_cells_le_overlap S J w hw _ hK`, then resolves through the existing import chain with no change. In HistogramOverlapEnergy.lean, change the call `local_mass_sum S J w hw _ hK` to the new name. Both uses keep their hypotheses: w is nonnegative and the overlap count is at most K.
findings.benefit: The double-counting proof is kept in one place. A future fix, such as dropping `classical` or changing the `simp` step, no longer has to be made twice. Readers also do not have to check that two lookalike lemmas really agree.

findings.excerpt:
have hmesh : (B : ℝ)*channelMesh (channelFineCount m B) ≤ 1 := by
    refine (channelMesh_scale_bound hm hBpos).trans ?_
    simpa using Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le
findings.problem: This is the third copy of the same non-trivial argument in the Counting files. It turns `channelMesh_scale_bound`, which gives B*mesh ≤ B^(-1/10), into B*mesh ≤ 1 by using B ≥ 1 and a monotone-exponent rpow bound. The same block appears in geometric_histogram_window_length, manuscript_histogram_overlap_energy, geometricWindow_pair_distance, geometricWindowKernel_bounds and several other files. Here `hmesh` is never used in the rest of the proof, so it is dead code carrying the whole repeated argument.
findings.proposed_change: Add one lemma next to `channelMesh_scale_bound` in HistogramScaleDecay.lean: `theorem channelMesh_scale_le_one {m B : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hB : 1 ≤ B) : (B : ℝ)*channelMesh (channelFineCount m B) ≤ 1`. Prove it with the block shown in this file: apply `(channelMesh_scale_bound hm (by omega)).trans`, then `simpa using Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (show (1:ℝ) ≤ B by exact_mod_cast hB) (by norm_num : (-(1/10:ℝ)) ≤ 0)`. In this theorem, delete the unused `hmesh` (lines 57–61). In geometric_histogram_window_length, geometricWindow_pair_distance and geometricWindowKernel_bounds, replace the local block with `have hmesh := channelMesh_scale_le_one hm hB`. In manuscript_histogram_overlap_energy the block is likewise unused and can be removed. The lemma needs only B ≥ 1, which every user already has as `hB : 1 ≤ B`. The proposed lemma and edits have not been compiled.
findings.benefit: About a dozen copies of a five-line analytic argument become one lemma with a descriptive name. The local proofs get shorter. An unused hypothesis that currently makes the residue theorem look as though it needs the mesh bound goes away.
